changelog:
Particles 1.9.0 (previous: 1.8.1)

- Per-axis size: Random Size and Size Curve have a Per Axis mode, and Set Attribute a Size Scale target. Quads use X/Y, meshes X/Y/Z, trails and ribbons X as width.
- Set Attribute targets Rotation (degrees) and Facing, and a Custom Facing quad orientation, for sparks and shards. New Spinning Embers template; Sparks now stretch along their velocity.
- Emissive map, colour, intensity and colour parameter on quads, trails and ribbons, plus a per-particle Emissive target. Six-way effects move their Texture-as-emissive into the emissive map.
- Soft Edge and Camera Fade distances per render type (defaults unchanged); the soft edge now also fades Blend Add.
- Distortion fixed: its texture and strength show in the editor, and distortion particles are drawn after all transparents so heat haze bends fire and smoke too. Without a texture they bend like a lens.
- The quad, trail and ribbon shaders ship in the package. GPU systems using the new size, rotation or emissive targets fall back to the CPU with a reason.
- Compatible with PlasmaEngine 0.11.1.
